999008199.text:
さて……事件もようやく一区切りついた。
いったん状況を整理しておこう

localizations.en: Now then... The case is finally wrapping up. Let's go over the situation while it's fresh.

999008199.text:
はい！　まず、ここ連日ベスティラを騒がせていた
獣人の娘が行方不明になっていた件ですが……

localizations.en: Right! First, regarding the string of disappearances of beastkin girls that's been plaguing Bestira...

999008199.text:
これはベスティラ王妃が個人的に
かわいい獣人の女の子を集めさせていたのが真相でした

localizations.en: The truth is that the Queen of Bestira was personally having cute beastkin girls collected.

999008199.text:
綺麗な黒髪の、猫耳の獣人の女の子が特に好きで
お持ち帰りしたかったと供述しています

localizations.en: She confessed that she particularly liked girls with beautiful black hair and cat ears, and wanted to take them home with her.

999008199.text: 綺麗な黒髪で、猫耳……

localizations.en: Beautiful black hair and cat ears...

999008199.text:
はぁ、だから謁見した時、耳触らせてとか
声をかけられたんだね……

localizations.en: So that's why she asked to touch my ears during the audience...

999008199.text:
実行犯の一人である賞金首「ヌルスラの鷹」は
一度は逃走を図ったもののジョゼによって捕縛

localizations.en: The Hawk of Nurslath, one of the accomplices and a wanted criminal, attempted to flee but was captured by José.

999008199.text:
現在は王宮の牢を一時的に借りて拘束している。
ベスティラ王も厳重に監視すると確約してくれた

localizations.en: He's currently being held in the palace's temporary cell. The King of Bestira has promised strict supervision.

999008199.text: 陛下は監察官に協力的なんですか？

localizations.en: Is His Majesty cooperating with the inspectors?

999008199.text:
はい。一連の事件は何も知らなかった様子で、王妃を
かわいさのあまり甘やかしすぎたと反省していましたよ

localizations.en: Yes. He seemed completely unaware of the whole affair and admitted he'd been too lenient with the queen because he adored her so much.

999008199.text:
「俺の代わりに監察本部でこってり絞ってやってくれ。
どんな結果になろうと俺はあいつを想っている」って

localizations.en: He said, 'Give her a proper scolding at headquarters for me. Whatever the outcome, I'll still love her.'

999008199.text:
……いい旦那さんだね。それ聞いたら王妃様も
なんで裏切っちゃったんだろうって後悔するよ

localizations.en: ...He's a good husband. If the queen heard that, she'd probably regret betraying him.

999008199.text:
まあ、あの豪快な王様は良くも悪くも
裏表がないっていうか、駆け引きできなそうだしね

localizations.en: Well, that boisterous king is straightforward in both good and bad ways. I doubt he's capable of deception.

999008199.text: 攫われてた獣人の女の子たちはどうなるの？

localizations.en: What's going to happen to the kidnapped beastkin girls?

999008199.text:
彼女たちは無事で、全員健康だ。
王妃が手厚くもてなしていたらしい

localizations.en: They're all safe and in good health. The queen apparently treated them quite well.

999008199.text:
基本、被害者家族の元に帰す予定だが
身寄りのない者や一部の者は帰りたくないと……

localizations.en: We're planning to return them to their families, but some have no relatives, and a few don't want to go back...

999008199.text:
酷い扱いは受けてなかったみたいで
それは不幸中の幸いですね～

localizations.en: It's a silver lining that they weren't mistreated.

999008199.text: 王妃様、愛情だけは本物だったんですね

localizations.en: So the queen's affection was genuine, at least.

999008199.text:
そうだね、そこは本当に救いだった。
まぁ誘拐には違いないので、もちろん罪だけども

localizations.en: That's true. It's genuinely fortunate. Though kidnapping is still kidnapping, so it's definitely a crime.

999008199.text:
俺は、誘拐が大嫌いでね。
王妃は厳しく罰してほしいもんだね

localizations.en: I personally despise kidnapping. I hope the queen receives a harsh punishment.

999008199.text:
……詳しくはこれからブラオールの本部で
取り調べて判断することになる。それと……

localizations.en: ...The details will be determined after interrogation at headquarters in Braulle. And...

999008199.text: 「ヌルスラの鷹」の賞金だ。確認してくれ、ジョゼ

localizations.en: This is the bounty for the Hawk of Nurslath. Verify the amount, José.

999008199.text: 確かに。賞金首捕縛の功績を独り占めして悪いね

localizations.en: Looks good. Sorry for hogging all the credit for capturing that bounty.

999008199.text:
誰が捕まえたかなどはどうでもいい。
大切なのは捕まえたという事実だ。協力感謝する

localizations.en: It doesn't matter who caught him. What matters is that he was caught. Thanks for your cooperation.

999008199.text: ……ジョゼさん

（さっきのあれって、タイニーさんに言ったら
　ただじゃおかないって脅迫だよね？　いったい……）

localizations.en: (Earlier... that was a threat, wasn't it? Saying he'd make sure I regret it if I told Tiny? What's going on...?)

999008199.text:
ボスはともかく、私は賞金首を捕まえて一人前に
なったはずなのに、結局半人前に元通りです……

localizations.en: My boss aside, I thought I'd become a full-fledged inspector after catching a wanted criminal, but I'm back to being a rookie again...

999008199.text:
なあに、嬢ちゃんならきっと一人前になれるさ。
くじけずに頑張るんだよ

localizations.en: Don't worry, you'll become a full-fledged inspector eventually. Just keep at it and don't give up.

999008199.text: 変てこ仮面さんに励まされても嬉しくありません！

localizations.en: I don't need encouragement from someone weirding a weird mask!

999008199.text:
……あ。
そういえば、武道会のほうはどうなったんですか？

localizations.en: ...Oh. Come to think of it, what happened with the tournament?

999008199.text:
こっちは大成功でした！　見事勝ち残り、
賞品として「九偉人図」をもらいましたよ！

localizations.en: It was a huge success! We won and received a Portrait of the Nine as our prize!

999008199.text: でも、最後のあの乱入にはびっくりしちゃったなあ

localizations.en: Though that surprise interruption at the end really caught us off guard.

999008199.text: え、乱入？　何があったんですか？

タイニーは残念だったね。あんなすごい戦いを
仕事で見逃しちゃったんだから

localizations.en: Too bad you missed it, Tiny. You were stuck working while all that amazing fighting was going on.

999008199.text:
え、ええ～？　本当に何があったんですか、
教えてくださいよ～！

localizations.en: W-what?! What happened? Come on, tell me!

999008199.text:
まぁまぁ。近いうちに時間を取って、
武道会のあらましは説明するよ

localizations.en: All right, all right. We'll find time soon to fill you in on everything that happened at the tournament.
